content: Net-worth products universally expect: accounts typed as assets vs liabilities, primary-currency rollup, historical NW chart, and per-account balances. Cloud aggregators (Empower/Monarch) default to bank sync; a parallel privacy/manual niche (Totala, Quantive, Worth it, Lunch Money editable monthly snapshots) treats dated balance snapshots as first-class. Multi-currency means native account currency + convert with rate-as-of-period. Credit cards are liabilities that subtract from NW; crypto usually asset class. Budgets/transactions/goals are adjacent products, not NW core.
